about_title: The Bekamak models the 2025/2026 catalogue does not show
about_text: Bekamak has built band saws in Turkey since 1990 with European components — NovoTech's premium line of band saws and circular saws, sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech Machine Tools from Mississauga, Ontario.

This supplement carries the Bekamak machines that are not in the Bekamak catalogue 2025/2026: the BMSO 320S servo-feed automatic band saw, the full BMSO CS NC double column range with the BMSO 460CS and the BMSO 1313CS for 51″ blocks, the TERRA 6 that runs its blade at up to 1,970 ft/min (600 m/min) and the OPUS 300 carbide circular saw for solid bar to Ø11-3/4″.
